page.layout: One page of running text, one column. Running head at top centre, page number at top left. A catchword at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: „à Spiritû Sancto fuerunt acti. Quan- „quàm institutionem hanc à Christo ipso „manare, vero verius habeam; eô quòd „hæc dies per excellentiam dies Dominicus „dicatur, Apoc. 1, 10. non tantùm quia „honori Christi dicatus, sed quia ab ipso „Christo institutus; adeò ut, quemadmo- „dùm Cœna vocatur Cœna Dominica 1 „Cor. xi, 20. quia scil. à Domino Jesû „fuit instituta, itàetiàm dicatur hic dies „Dominicus, quia à Domino institutus. „Rationes ex Amesio hùc adscribam. Quia „non minùs fidelis fuit Christus in totâ „domo, vel Ecclesiâ Dei, ordinandâ, „quoad omnia generaliter necessaria & „utilia, quàm fuit Moses; Heb. iii, 2, 6. „Sed hujus diei observationem generaliter „utilem esse, & aliquo modo necessariam „Ecclesiis Christi, nemo Christianus potest „cum ullâ ratione negare. &c.

„Adferuntur quædam ab Adversariis „in contrariam sententiam, ex Rom. „xiv, 5. qui æstimant diem præ die. Gal. „iv, 10, 11. Dies observatis, & menses, „& tempora, & annos. Col. ii, 15. Ne „quis vos damnet ob cibum vel potum ;aut

page.notes: The line-initial „ marks are printed quotation marks at each line of the quoted passage. Text ends at the bottom of the page; "ne-" below the last line is the catchword. Line-end "aut" is cut off at the right edge of the scan. Some letters in the scan are blurred, notably in "Christi" and "Adferuntur", but they are legible.
